name: SANS DFIR Summit & Training 2026
notes: Strong DFIR content + optional training courses. Great for leveling up and meeting working practitioners.

name: Techno Security & Digital Forensics Conference (East) 2026
notes: Large community conference with a blend of DFIR + cyber + eDiscovery. Good for networking and broad exposure.

name: Techno Security & Digital Forensics Conference (West) 2026
notes: West coast edition. Similar mix of DFIR + cyber + eDiscovery, great for meeting vendors and practitioners.

name: IACIS 2026 Orlando Training Conference
notes: Training-focused event (BCFE). If you want structure + fundamentals, this is a strong route.

name: DFRWS USA 2026
notes: Research-focused DFIR conference: papers, workshops, posters/demos. Great if you like academic + validation-heavy work.
